line_items.reasoning: AMD reported record Q3 revenue of $9.2B, exceeding the high end of the guided range of $8.7B ± $300M (i.e., up to $9.0B) by ~$200M and delivering 36% YoY growth vs. the guided ~28%.
Non-GAAP gross margin came in at 54%, exactly matching the guided ~54% target for Q3.
Data Center revenue grew 34% sequentially to a record $4.3B, well above the 'strong double-digit sequential growth' guided, and Instinct GPU revenue grew YoY as expected.

Client & Gaming surged 73% YoY to a record $4.0B (vs. guided 'modest sequential growth'), with Gaming up 181% YoY — a massive outperformance; however, Embedded declined 8% YoY to $857M, missing the guided 'return to sequential growth.'
No explicit contradictions were reported for non-GAAP opex (~$2.55B), tax rate (13%), or diluted share count (~1.63B), suggesting these came in roughly as guided.
